name: Bounty Board
oracle_text:
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
{1}, {T}: Put a bounty counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
Whenever a creature with a bounty counter on it dies, each of its controller's opponents draws a card and gains 2 life.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a creature with a bounty counter on it dies, each of its controller's opponents draws a card and gains 2 life.

needs.what: a player spec (or a DIES/LEAVES_BATTLEFIELD event binding such as `had_controller`) naming the player who controlled the creature as it last existed on the battlefield (608.2h), so "each of its controller's opponents" can be written as {"not": {<that controller>}} on a creature_dies trigger
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `{"not": {"controller_of": "subject"}}` is the near miss: `controller_of` reads the bound object's current `controller`, and on a death that object is already in the graveyard after `reset_permanent_state` has put control back to the owner. zones.move_object snapshots `controller_before` but passes it only to the SACRIFICED event, and the DIES payload carries had_counters/had_power/etc. but no controller. So a stolen creature with a bounty counter dying would reward the owner's opponents (including the thief) instead of the controller's opponents (including the owner) -- a different card. The rest of the line is expressible: creature_dies with controller any, condition counters_had "bounty" >= 1, then draw 1 and gain_life 2 for each player in the spec.
